verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents a programmatic Python API (AsyncWebCrawler / arun) and ships a Dockerized FastAPI server with an interactive playground that generates request code, so it can be driven programmatically. The HTTP API surface is only thinly evidenced, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard docs paths. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/endpoint reference for the REST server, detailed HTTP API documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: async with AsyncWebCrawler() as crawler: result = await crawler.arun(url="https://crawl4ai.com") print(result.markdown)
Dockerized Setup: Optimized Docker image with FastAPI server for easy deployment.
Interactive playground to test and generate request code
